# Adrian Treleaven

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-thirties  <sub>[v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c6 P4](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive, married  <sub>[v4 c36 P24](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0024), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ontario (grandson of John Tremayne of Seven Gulls Harbor)  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v4 c6 P4](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0004), [v4 c7 P4](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Journalist and author  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v4 c6 P4](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0004), [v4 c23 P15](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0015), [v4 c24 P23](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Adrian is a tall, broad-shouldered man with thick brown hair, a sharp nose and chin, and large, luminous dark-gray eyes that give him a reflective and handsome countenance. When he smiles, his face lights up with warmth and charm, showing white, even teeth. However, when unsmiling, he can carry a somewhat sad, distracted expression.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P4](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0004), [v4 c23 P4](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0004)_

## Personality

Adrian is warm, open, and articulate, possessing a deep appreciation for beauty, nature, and storytelling. He is passionate about his writing, often becoming completely absorbed in his creative work. Though candid and emotionally sincere, he exhibits high moral integrity and restraint when facing difficult personal dilemmas.

_Sources: [v4 c7 P4](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0004), [v4 c7 P49](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0049), [v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006), [v4 c26 P5](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0005), [v4 c26 P11](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0011)_

## Goals

- Write a major Canadian novel based on Captain Saul's life-book  <sub>[v4 c7 P19](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0019), [v4 c25 P1](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0001)</sub>

## History

After recovering from typhoid fever, Adrian traveled to Seven Gulls Harbor to spend the summer at Echo Cottage, boarding with Lorna Vane while researching his grandfather's former home. During his stay, he became close friends with Nell and Hugh Carrow, and met Captain Saul Garrick, whose adventurous sea journals inspired him to write a collaborative biographical novel. Over the course of the summer, he fell deeply in love with Lorna Vane, though he initially kept his feelings hidden out of respect for her difficult marriage to her incapacitated husband, Rufus. When it was later revealed that the man was actually Rufus's cousin Laurence, and that the real Rufus had died years earlier, Lorna was freed from her marital ties. Following his departure to finish his novel, Adrian returned to marry Lorna at Echo Cottage before embarking on a trip to Japan.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v4 c6 P4](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0004), [v4 c7 P4](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0004), [v4 c25 P1](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0001), [v4 c26 P5](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0005), [v4 c31 P19](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0019), [v4 c31 P27](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0027), [v4 c36 P24](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0024), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Grandson of early Seven Gulls schoolmaster John Tremayne and Damaris Leigh  <sub>[v4 c6 P4](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0004), [v4 c7 P4](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0004)</sub>
- Son of Alice Tremayne, who grew up in Seven Gulls Harbor  <sub>[v4 c7 P4](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0004), [v4 c7 P11](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0011)</sub>
- Spent time traveling in Europe with his mother prior to her passing  <sub>[v4 c6 P35](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0035), [v4 c7 P11](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0011)</sub>
- Suffered a severe bout of typhoid fever prior to visiting Seven Gulls Harbor  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Quotes

> The soul will be provided by you and the body by me. Oh, Captain Saul, a renowned book will be authored by the two of us.  <sub>[v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006)</sub>

> Lorna is loved by me, Mrs. Carrow. LOVED! A word that faint hardly seems sufficient!  <sub>[v4 c26 P3](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0003)</sub>

> For a second, I had no choice—I couldn't prevent loving her. Loving her and parting from her causes a scorching, searing agony—yet never having loved her remains completely unimaginable.  <sub>[v4 c26 P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018)</sub>
